regimeSub: Yields rip higher as 2Y surges 14bps to 4.85% with Brent breaking $105 on renewed Mideast supply fears.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% + hawkish forward guidance reverberates → 2Y jumps 14bps to 4.85% and 10Y breaks 5.11% as market prices another 25bp hike by Dec while Q2 GDP stuck at 1.5%

Brent crude spikes to $105.36 from $97.30 on Saudi output disruptions per WSJ Sept 10 → oil pass-through threatens Aug CPI 3.7% extending higher, gold rallies to $4318 as stagflation hedge bid intensifies
BOK faces widening 1%pt rate gap vs Fed → USDKRW narrows to 1359 from 1371 on KRW strength as SK chip exports surge, but BOK Sept 10 flagged chip boom inflation risks may force further tightening
Core retail sales hit record per Census Sept 24 release → consumer resilience at +1.2% MoM keeps Warsh boxed into hawkish stance, core PCE at 3.3% still 130bps above 2% target

signalNotes.note: Real rate +115bps (4.85% 2Y vs 3.7% CPI) → most restrictive since 2007, squeezing duration assets hard

signalNotes.note: Curve steepens to -26bps from -25bps as long-end sells off harder on term premium repricing + fiscal fears

signalNotes.note: HY spreads stable but vulnerable as 5%+ 10Y yield pressures leveraged balance sheets into Q4 refinancing

signalNotes.name: VIX
signalNotes.note: VIX at 15.67 remains subdued despite rate vol → equity complacency vs bond market stress is a divergence to watch

signalNotes.name: Brent Crude
signalNotes.note: Brent +8.3% to $105.36 on Saudi disruptions per WSJ → biggest 1-day move since June Hormuz crisis

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: Gold at $4318 flat on week as stagflation hedge demand offsets rising real rates → breakout above $4400 signals panic

signalNotes.note: Nikkei +0.9%, KOSPI holds 7080 → SK Hynix HBM demand insulates Asia tech from US rate shock for now

headline: Stagflation grip tightens as 10Y breaks 5.11% and Brent surges to $105 while Warsh's hiking cycle collides with 1.5% GDP growth.
